prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Listen to Companion Voice Styles", "Sample how your desktop pet expresses happiness, curiosity, and playfulness.", "Playful Bark & Chirp", "Calm Meow & Purr", "Continue to Adoption"]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Engine", "Listen to your pet's custom sound effects while setting up.", "Previewing desktop audio cues and voice alerts..."]
2: ["Test Pet Desktop Commands Now", "Try pressing spacebar or speaking 'Hey Pet' to verify controls before finishing setup.", "Test Voice Command", "Press Alt+P to hide or summon your pet anytime."]
3: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet customization and progress are automatically saved to your cloud account.", "Automatic pet backup across system reinstalls", "Sign In with Google / Email"]
4: ["What Your Desktop Companion Can Do", "Pets roam your desktop, react to your work status, and entertain you with mini-games.", "Choose My Path"]
5: []
6: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Learn how to summon, minimize, and direct your pet around desktop windows.", "Right-click pet for Quick Menu", "Double-click pet to play sound | Drag pet to pin on taskbar"]
7: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Tip: Click and hold pet for 2 seconds to put companion to sleep.", "Gesture Tip: Drag to bottom right corner to send pet to tray"]
8: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open quick settings, feed, or send to system tray.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate Granted!", "Your customized desktop companion is officially registered and ready to meet you.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
